reason: Acute pancreatitis with Grade 3 lipase/amylase, neutropenia, and obesity presents immediate life-threatening risks of septic shock and multi-organ failure. Urgent ABC assessment, aggressive IV fluids, and monitoring for organ dysfunction are critical. Prior survival estimate of 0.35 was too optimistic given these acute findings.
evidences: ATLS primary survey and resuscitation protocols
Surviving Sepsis Campaign guidelines for early goal-directed therapy
Pancreatitis management guidelines (IAP/APA) emphasizing early risk stratification
